description: A free digital painting application (Krita 6.0 portable build)
notes: Latest Krita 6.0 line release, portable build extracted from the official krita-x64 zip (KDE stable mirror).
Settings and resources live in %APPDATA%\krita and in the ResourceDirectory set in kritarc, shared with any other Krita install on this machine.
Shortcut uses the unbranded classic Krita icon (scripts/krita-default.ico); the running window/taskbar icon is overridden by the nobeta_icon pykrita plugin.
Pinned to 6.0.4.1 without checkver/autoupdate: KDE's directory listing sorts 6.0.4.1 after 6.0.4, which would make an automatic bump downgrade.
